eventDetail.scope: The 2026 International Conference on Emerging Trends in Engineering & Computing (ETECOM) is the second edition of the ETECOM conference series. IEEE ETECOM 2026 will be organized by ENSTA Paris, Polytechnic Institute of Paris, and technically co-sponsored by IEEE France Section. It will be hosted by the ENSTA Polytechnic Institute of Paris, France. This conference targets a broad and interdisciplinary audience, including researchers, practitioners, and educators interested in the latest advancements in artificial intelligence, data analytics, wireless communications, networking, cloud and edge computing, cyber-physical systems, security, green engineering & computing, GIS, intelligent transportation, smart grids, and engineering education.
